heading.title: Representative Title to Property of Deceased on Succession

article.title: [Right as executor or legatee when established.]
article.html:
213[Right as executor or legatee when established.]

Omitted by the Repealing and Amending Act, 2025 (37 of 2025), s. 3 and Sch. II (w.e.f. 20-12-2025).

Note: footnote 3 on page 67 has no marker in the printed text: the words it substituted stood in sub-section (2), which the Repealing and Amending Act, 2025 omitted with the rest of the section.

Subs. by Act 3 of 1951, s. 3 and the Schedule, for “the States”.

State amendment · Kerala

Amendment of section 213.—In sub-section (2) of section 213 of the Indian Succession Act, 1925 (Central Act 39 of 1925), after the word ‘Muhammadans’, the words ‘or Indian Christians’ shall be inserted.

[Vide Kerala Act 1 of 1997, sec. 2].
